plugin.name: Tony Hawk's Underground 2 Widescreen Fix
ResX.description: 0 uses the desktop resolution. Set both width and height to use another one. Takes effect when the game starts.
FixHUD.description: Scales and places the HUD and menus correctly at widescreen aspect ratios. Takes effect when the game starts.
FixFOV.description: Keeps the original vertical field of view and widens it at the sides (Hor+). Takes effect when the game starts.
RandomSongOrderFix.description: Shuffles the whole soundtrack instead of playing it in the same order every time. Takes effect when the game starts.
WindowMode.description: Fullscreen, a framed window, or borderless covering the monitor. Takes effect when the game starts.
SkipIntro.description: Skips the publisher, studio and technology logo videos. Story videos stay. Takes effect when the game starts.
MAIN.FOVFactor.description: Widens or narrows the gameplay camera. 1.0 is the game's own framing. Animated, fixed and zoomed views keep theirs.
MAIN.FMVWidescreenMode.description: Fullscreen videos: original aspect with black bars, filled at the correct aspect (edges cropped), or stretched.
MAIN.HudAspectRatioConstraint.descriptio: Keeps the HUD elements at the screen sides inside a centered box of this aspect ratio. Automatic uses the whole screen width. Split screen is unchanged.
MAIN_ConfineCursor.description: Keeps the cursor inside the game window while it is active. Released while unfocused, dragging or using system menus, and at once when turned off.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu (this fix and other plugins). Automatic follows the game.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply settings.
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything turned up
